document: OneGate component and dependency inventory (machine-readable companion of the System Handbook)

verification_labels.CODE: read in repository at the reviewed commit
verification_labels.LIVE: observed read-only on PRE-LIVE or Central
verification_labels.DISPOSABLE: measured on a disposable DB/container built from the repo
verification_labels.DOC: stated by a document, not exercised
verification_labels.VM: Executed on the fresh, isolated test VM pair (VMware ESXi, Ubuntu 22.04.5) on 2026-10-27; installation manual Appendix 3
verification_labels.SELFTEST: Covered by a self-test in scripts/ci/ or a script --self-test

components.name: scd — session controller and guest authority
components.if_stopped: No new sign-ins/activations; admin actions that proxy to scd fail; existing Clients continue while acctd/netd renew leases (<=90 s); systemd restarts in 2 s
components.detection_recovery: edged health probes the socket; journalctl -u stayconnect-scd; restart via stop/reset-failed/start --no-block

components.name: netd — privileged network daemon
components.if_stopped: No network changes; new sessions stay PENDING_ENFORCEMENT; authorised addresses lapse when nft timeouts (<=90 s) expire (fail-closed)
components.detection_recovery: edged health (critical); netd recover status|reassert-confirmed; boot reconcile

components.name: acctd — accounting and enforcement producer
components.if_stopped: No plan renewals (Client access lapses ~90 s); no quota/expiry enforcement or accounting

components.name: edged — Admin Console API
components.if_stopped: Admin Console unusable; all operators signed out on restart; Client plane unaffected

components.name: portald — Client Portal
components.if_stopped: New Clients cannot reach the sign-in page; authorised Clients unaffected; network apply rolls back (portal_listen)

components.name: pmsd — PMS connector
components.if_stopped: Mirror stops updating; room sign-in only while stored runtime row reads not-connected; no room charge
components.detection_recovery: NOT in edged health list; journal / pms_interface_runtime
components.notes: Installed but NOT enabled by the provisioner; enabled+active on PRE-LIVE; exits 0 when flags are off

components.name: Admin Console (Next.js standalone)
components.if_stopped: Console 502 via Caddy; edged still up on loopback

components.name: keybootstrap — local key bootstrap
components.if_stopped: scd cannot start without voucher/throttle/OTP keys
components.notes: Built by default (K3 fixed)

components.name: svc-run — start-up back-off wrapper
components.if_stopped: Caddy / Admin Console units fail ExecStartPre if absent
components.notes: Built by default (K3 fixed)

components.name: phase3-foundation — manual nft foundation tool
components.notes: netd keeps the foundation durable in-process

components.name: Caddy (appliance)
components.if_stopped: Admin Console unreachable; Client Portal unaffected

components.name: Kea DHCPv4
components.if_stopped: No DHCP for new Clients
components.notes: Installed stopped+disabled by provisioner; started by netd on first apply

components.name: Unbound DNS
components.if_stopped: No Client DNS; captive detection breaks

components.name: nftables (table inet stayconnect)
components.if_stopped: Rules persist until flushed; netd re-asserts every 10 s

components.name: tc HTB + IFB shaping
components.if_stopped: Classes persist until reboot

components.name: conntrack flush
components.if_stopped: Revoked Clients could keep established flows

components.name: netplan / systemd-networkd
components.if_stopped: Boot persistence of bridges/VLANs only

components.name: Docker Engine + containerd
components.if_stopped: Database and Redis containers stop

components.name: OpenSSH server
components.if_stopped: No remote administration

components.name: systemd-timesyncd
components.if_stopped: Clock drift breaks licence clock high-water and JWT validity

components.name: stayconnect-pg (PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB)
components.if_stopped: Guest auth fails; services retry; netd starts from last-confirmed.json
components.notes: 49 public + 169 iam_v2 tables; hypertables accounting_records, audit_log; ledger head 0158 on PRE-LIVE

components.name: provision-fresh-appliance.sh
components.notes: Run by appliance-install.sh. Idempotent; database via site-db-init.sh; writes the product profile (commerce + enforcement plane) and checks it; installs dnsutils/age/openssl; hard-fails on missing trust

components.name: install-service-units.sh
components.notes: Installs units, *.service.d drop-ins, Kea/Unbound overrides and polkit (.pkla on polkit <= 0.105, .rules otherwise)

components.name: build-appliance-binaries.sh
components.notes: Default SERVICES include keybootstrap and svc-run; Go caches in named Docker volumes; called by appliance-build.sh

components.name: deploy-hotel-admin.sh (package|install|rollback|verify)
components.notes: RUN_USER defaults to stayconnect-hotel-admin when that account exists

components.name: edge-migrate.sh
components.notes: Live-site mode needs a verified pre-change backup (exit 4); run per version by apply-pending-migrations.sh on upgrade; needs iam_v2_owner SELECT,INSERT on public.schema_migrations (granted by gatep-iam-roles.sql)

components.name: Gate-P (gatep-*.sql, gatep-reconcile.sh, gatep-set-passwords.sh)

components.name: appliance-build.sh — appliance release build
components.notes: Fresh clone of one commit; 8 binaries + Admin Console + deploy tree + migrations + RELEASE.json + SHA256SUMS -> onegate-appliance-<sha12>.tar.gz; refuses a stale baseline

components.name: appliance-install.sh — install / re-run / resume / --upgrade
components.notes: The one supported entry point; verifies the release, checks the platform (Ubuntu 22.04 amd64, 2 NICs, >=4 GiB, >=15 GiB), stages, pins trust, provisions, installs console, creates the first admin, records provenance

components.name: site-db-init.sh — factory-clean site database
components.notes: Baseline in one transaction on a blank schema only; complete = skip; partial = refuse (data-free rebuild with --reinitialise-unused); self-test 10/10

components.name: apply-pending-migrations.sh
components.notes: Floor = ledger max or /etc/stayconnect/schema-baseline; each pending migration through edge-migrate.sh live-site; then gatep-reconcile; self-test 5/5

components.name: create-first-admin.sh
components.notes: No password on a command line; >=12 chars; existing same admin = no-op; --reset = break-glass password reset

components.name: restore-appliance-config.sh
components.notes: Restores etc-<stamp>.tgz.age under /etc and keeps this machine's DB credentials; self-test 10/10

components.name: client-journey-netns-test.sh
components.notes: Test appliances only: a namespace Client on the Client bridge, DHCP -> DNS -> portal -> voucher -> entitlement -> enforcement -> Internet -> accounting

known_install_gaps: G9 pmsd and the PMS surface flags stay off until a PMS is commissioned (by design; manual C.10)
G12 hostname and WAN netplan are the operator's (by design)
G15 no installer for observability/HA (not implemented)
install_path_updated: 2026-10-27: fresh-VM installer mission (appliance-build.sh / appliance-install.sh), validated on a fresh VMware ESXi / Ubuntu 22.04.5 VM pair

validation_environment.description: isolated test pair; not PRE-LIVE, not the production Central; separate trust universe

resolved_install_gaps: G2/K3 -> keybootstrap and svc-run built by default
G3/K1 -> baseline regenerated through 0158; build and install refuse a stale baseline
K2 -> site-db-init.sh (one-transaction baseline, blank schema only)
K5 -> built at the release schema; schema-baseline marker; upgrades via apply-pending-migrations.sh
G7 -> install-service-units.sh installs drop-ins, overrides and polkit
G10 -> provisioner writes the commerce + enforcement-plane profile and checks it
